say:2:1121176002:1.text: ... It... it's all coming back. My identity, past, and the reason I lost my memory...
say:2:1121176002:1.source_cn: ……我，全都想起来了。身份，过去，还有我会失去记忆的原因……

say:3:1121176003:2.text: The Hypogean I pursued was skilled at hiding in other dimensions. When we fought, I was struck by his spell... That's how I was <style="highlight">split into two</style>.
say:3:1121176003:2.source_cn: 我之前追击的那个恶魔，善于躲进另一个空间中。交手时，我...

say:4:1121176004:1.text: The Hypogean's power is more akin to <style="highlight">divisive symmetry</style> than replication.
say:4:1121176004:1.source_cn: 比起复制，他的力量，更像是<style=highlig...

say:5:1121176005:1.text: However, powers bestowed by the gods cannot be taken away. I lost my memory but retained my Celestial magic.
say:5:1121176005:1.source_cn: 但是，只有神明赐予的力量，他无法夺走。所以我只是失去了...

say:6:1121176006:1.text: Was that the reason you were surrounded by the aura of a Hypogean?
say:6:1121176006:1.source_cn: 塔琳小姐之前身上带有恶魔气息，也是因为这个原因吗？

say:7:1121176007:1.text: Wherever I went, there were always Hypofiend attacks, but it was actually the residual Hypogean aura on my body that drew them near.
say:7:1121176007:1.source_cn: 我所到之处，总会出现魔物袭击，其实是身上残留的恶魔气息...

say:8:1121176008:2.text: It's fortunate that I found you all.

choice_prompt:9:1121176008.text: It's fortunate that I found you all.

say:10:1121176009:1.text: Many thanks. Now I'm stronger and more whole than ever before.
say:10:1121176009:1.source_cn: 谢谢你，此时的我，前所未有的强大与完整。
say:10:1121176009:1.male: Many thanks. Now I'm stronger and more whole than ever before.
say:10:1121176009:1.female: Many thanks. Now I'm stronger and more whole than ever before.

say:11:1121176010:1.text: So, Lyca... Have you made your decision?
say:11:1121176010:1.source_cn: ——那么，莱卡。你现在做出决定了吗？

say:12:1121176011:1.text: ... The way forward is clear, Archon Talene. I understand all you've stood for and have witnessed your power firsthand.
say:12:1121176011:1.source_cn: ……不，不用说了，塔琳殿下。我明白你的意思，并且也亲眼...

say:13:1121176012:1.text: It would be blasphemy against Misarte to allow Hypogean magic to thrive in such a sacred place!
say:13:1121176012:1.source_cn: 如果我允许恶魔的造物继续摆在神圣的祭坛之上，那才是对弥...

say:14:1121176013:1.text: Let us go to the Spirit Mound.

choice:9:0:1.source_cn: 没想到竟然能帮上半神的忙
